name: Number Sense
description: Work with fractions, decimals, negatives and powers until each one feels like an amount, then with factors, measures and averages.

lessonNames.l4-fraction-of-fraction: Taking a fraction of a fraction
lessonNames.l5-how-many-halves: How many halves fit in three?
lessonNames.l9-negative-times-negative: Why a negative times a negative is positive
lessonNames.l14-very-big-very-small: Very big and very small numbers
lessonNames.l15-building-blocks: The building blocks of a number
lessonNames.l17-around-and-inside: Around a shape and inside it

lessonObjectives.l1-what-a-fraction-measures: Read a fraction as a number of equal parts of one whole, and place it on a number line.
lessonObjectives.l2-same-amount: Find equivalent fractions by splitting or merging the parts.
lessonObjectives.l3-adding-pieces: Add and subtract fractions by first cutting both into pieces of a common size.
lessonObjectives.l4-fraction-of-fraction: Multiply fractions with an area model and explain why the answer can be smaller than both.
lessonObjectives.l5-how-many-halves: Divide by a fraction by counting how many times it fits, then see why we flip and multiply.
lessonObjectives.l6-place-value: Place decimals on a number line and compare them digit by digit.
lessonObjectives.l7-fractions-to-decimals: Convert fractions to terminating and recurring decimals by division.
lessonObjectives.l8-below-zero: Add and subtract negative numbers as moves along a number line.
lessonObjectives.l9-negative-times-negative: Multiply and divide negatives, and justify the sign rules from a pattern.
lessonObjectives.l10-repeated-multiplication: Write repeated multiplication as a power and discover the index laws.
lessonObjectives.l11-undoing-a-square: Find square and cube roots, and estimate a root between two whole numbers.
lessonObjectives.l12-which-first: Evaluate expressions with brackets, powers and the four operations in the right order.
lessonObjectives.l13-estimate-first: Round to one significant figure to check a calculation in your head.
lessonObjectives.l14-very-big-very-small: Write, compare and multiply numbers in standard form.
lessonObjectives.l15-building-blocks: Find the factors and multiples of a number, recognise primes, and write a number as a product of primes.
lessonObjectives.l16-shared-factors: Find the highest common factor and lowest common multiple of two numbers from their prime factors.
lessonObjectives.l17-around-and-inside: Find the perimeter and area of rectangles, triangles, parallelograms and shapes built from them.
lessonObjectives.l18-circles-and-units: Find the circumference and area of a circle, and convert between units of length, area and time.
lessonObjectives.l19-one-number-for-many: Find the mean, median, mode and range of a data set, and read them from a table or a chart.
